notes.title: Brief Karate Foolish world championship 2019
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26640775/c29b5a478017d5c45cf0aea0f04e0032f6be4d51.png[/img]

[h1]Burning summer of brief pants has arrived![/h1]
We will hold this year's Brief Karate Foolish world championship on June 22th at Osaka.

In this year, we got a fund from platinum brief sponsor [h1]THIRD WAVE CORPORATION[/h1], they are also known as [h1]DOSPARA[/h1] PC parts shop.
The participant and winner will get gorgeous prizes, such as Brief Karate goods or DOSPARA shop points.

You can entry the tournament from this page:
https://twipla.jp/events/385961

[h1]Win the prizes, Brief Fighters![/h1]
